scope: Proposition 4.3 of the manuscript “The Singer conjecture in dimension four” (preprints/The-Singer-conjecture-in-dimension-four-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 315 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 179f73885d0c7f47), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: If gn → a ∈ B and g−1 n → b ∈ B, then gnx −→ a uniformly for x in each compact subset of X \ {b}. (4.4) Consequently the action of Γ on the space of distinct triples of B is properly discontinuous; in particular, its action on B is a convergence action.
